required_global_badge: Fictional educational scenario — not a patient record
case_selection_policy: Cases select a predetermined educational scene only. They do not diagnose, triage, recommend treatment, rank options, or predict an outcome.

cases.subtitle: Right-M1 anatomy orientation
cases.portrait_alt: Synthetic head-and-shoulders portrait used only to identify Fictional Scenario 01.
learning_focus: Locate the generic cerebral arteries and conceptual right-M1 marker.
Distinguish structural anatomy from illustrative flow cues.
Practice restoring the complete orientation view.

cases.subtitle: Qualitative flow-cue comparison
cases.portrait_alt: Synthetic head-and-shoulders portrait used only to identify Fictional Scenario 02.
learning_focus: Compare baseline, restricted, and restored illustrative display states.
Recognize that arrows and marker timing do not encode velocity, pressure, perfusion, or outcome.
Use Pause and Replay with an explicit motion preference.

cases.subtitle: Structural anatomy detail
cases.portrait_alt: Synthetic head-and-shoulders portrait used only to identify Fictional Scenario 03.
learning_focus: Inspect one reviewed structural atlas focus at a time.
Keep structural labels separate from functional or deficit claims.
Reveal internal structures only after hiding or cutting obscuring anatomy.

cases.subtitle: Magnified vessel teaching view
cases.portrait_alt: Synthetic head-and-shoulders portrait used only to identify Fictional Scenario 04.
learning_focus: Open a detached magnified vessel-wall teaching view.
Keep micro-scale thrombus content separate from the registered head.
Read the persistent conceptual and not-to-scale warning.
